historic_survey.finding: Not eligible for the National Register, the California Register or City Landmark designation
historic_survey.physical_integrity: Retains design, workmanship, materials, feeling, association, location and setting
historic_survey.note: One of eight parcels the evaluation surveyed intensively, and one of five buildings the proposed Diamond/Bosworth infill site would demolish. Building permits give V. Teslo as architect; archival research turned up nothing further, and he is not in the city directories of the 1920s. The evaluation describes a three-story apartment building, and the assessor a two-story single-family dwelling.
